parameters.name: AuthenticationMethod
parameters.description: Specifies how 3rd Party Applications have to authenticate against Femto APIs in order to use it. {{reference}} '''''Note:''''' The credentials are not part of the data model and have to be supplied externally.

parameters.name: TunnelInst
parameters.description: This is the reference to the IPsec tunnel instance to be used by the Application Platform traffic. The {{param}} MUST point to a tunnel instance defined in the data model. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string.

object.description: This object contains parameters related to the operation of the Femtozone APIs.
